Expression of Interest (EOI) is invited on behalf of the Governor of Mizoram from Authorised Dealers/Distributors for "Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of 400kVA Diesel Generator (3-Phase CPCB-4) at Zodin Multi Level Car Parking cum Utility Centre, Aizawl" under Urban Development & Poverty Alleviation Department, Mizoram. Expression of Interest documents can be downloaded from the Department's website udpa.mizoram.gov.in or State Public Procurement Portal at tender.mizoram.gov.in or can be purchased from the Technical Branch of UD&PA Department on payment of ₹1,000.00 during office working hours from 1.11.2026 till 14.11.2026. Last date of submission of Expression of Interest documents is 16.11.2026 at 1:00 p.m. and shall be opened on the same day at 1:30 p.m. in the office chamber of the undersigned.
